title: The Morning Digest: November 6, 2026
dek: Brent Jan27 settled at $98.29 on Thursday, up $3.67 or 3.9 percent, and WTI Dec26 settled at $90.52, up $2.40 or 2.7 percent (Bloomberg via Rigzone), recovering part of Wednesday's falls, and overnight Brent briefly traded above $100 before holding at $99.58 at 0504 GMT (Reuters). Both benchmarks remain down about 12 percent on the week. UKMTO counts at least five vessel incidents since Sunday, close to October's record pace, while Iranian mine claims for Thursday remain unconfirmed. December WCS is -$30.15 (ICE TMW settle, Nov 5) on zero lots, a mark rather than a traded settle, while April through June tightened on 835 lots a tenor. December Houston is -$20.27 (ICE ARV settle, Nov 5), putting the export spread at +$9.88. The validated diesel crack is $91.94. Canadian Natural confirmed the Horizon turnaround complete, seven days ahead of schedule.
